work.name: Bombay Stock Exchange Ltd.
highlights: Conducted risk and vulnerability analysis of critical exchange systems
Monitored and mitigated active threats using IBM QRadar (SIEM) and IBM Watson
Deployed Honeycomb trapping techniques as an active decoy to enhance threat detection

projects.name: Multi-Expert Hybrid Retrieval for Movie Recommendation
projects.description: M.S. Thesis — multi-expert retrieval combining semantic, lexical, collaborative, and emotion-aware experts with a learned BTL query router.
highlights: Learned query router trained with Bradley–Terry–Luce pairwise loss over 9,000 human-judged movie pairs
Up to 4.5% higher pairwise agreement over BGE-Reranker, Qwen-1.5B, Kimi-K2 on MovieLens-100K

projects.name: Indian Multilingual Jailbreaking
projects.description: Built Indic-JailbreakBench and proposed four jailbreak techniques achieving up to 35% higher ASR in Indic languages.
highlights: 1,668 multilingual malicious prompts across 12 harm categories
Evaluated six state-of-the-art LLMs with a multi-judge ASR framework

projects.name: NutritionRAG — Grounded Nutrition Chatbot
projects.description: Full RAG pipeline with web app using hybrid BM25 + ANN retrieval over a textbook corpus stored in pgvector.
highlights: Semantic chunking and pgvector embedding storage
Hybrid BM25 + ANN retrieval with inline citations

projects.name: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) from Scratch
projects.description: End-to-end PyTorch implementation of DPO to align LLM outputs with human preference data.
highlights: Full training loop optimizing reward functions to prefer human-aligned over rejected outputs

projects.name: Signboard OCR & Transliteration
projects.description: Multilingual OCR pipeline with Faster R-CNN and GRU encoder-decoder for Hindi-to-English transliteration.

projects.name: Cross-Lingual Emotion Understanding for Indic Languages
projects.description: Teacher-student distillation of RoBERTa-GoEmotions into IndicBERT across 5 Indic languages.
highlights: ~3.3x improvement over zero-shot baselines on Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Tamil
